goal.title: Mit Vektoren in der Ebene rechnen
goal.description: Die lernende Person kann Komponentenpaare addieren, subtrahieren und mit einem Skalar multiplizieren. Sie erklärt die komponentenweise Addition durch Verkettung der Verschiebungspfeile und erklärt am Pfeil die Wirkung eines negativen oder gebrochenen Faktors und des Faktors null.
goal.descriptionEn: The learner can add and subtract component pairs and multiply them by a scalar. They explain component-wise addition by composing displacement arrows and use an arrow to explain the effect of a negative, fractional or zero scale factor.

recommendation: Accept only this APV-203 for the named curricular goal and dimension. Keep the declaration at exactly its source-supported states. Its recently reviewed direct mappings substantiate this scope. Ancestor mappings and prerequisite closure are evidence of compiled visibility across sixteen states, not source evidence for a regular target in each state. With the inheritance boundary added only on scratch, partial-mapping diagnostics shrink to the declared states while prerequisite closure still yields sixteen and preserves APV-203. Declaring all sixteen would purport to have 13 additional states without a goal-level witness. The positive targets are exactly the listed authored view memberships. Other stage or jurisdiction contexts rely only on their existing prerequisite paths. The warnings of any other goal stay independently reviewable.
countermodelScope: directOnly adds the existing mapping inheritance boundary on a scratch copy to separate direct from inherited source evidence; it is not an authored catalog change.
